policies.source: These are deliberately authored cross-generation MMO habitats derived from reviewed map artwork and the project guide/types. They are not original Unbound ROM encounter tables.
policies.varieties: Normal311/336; Shiny, Dark, Mystic, Metallic and Shadow each5/336, through the unchanged shared player/AI roller.
policies.levels: Early habitats start2–5. Progression rises to21–24 for high areas. Established evolution thresholds constrain low-area evolved species; values above24 compress to21. No wild entry exceeds24; owned progression stays unchanged.
policies.coverage: All ordinary guide species with six valid exact local GIF sprites receive at least one compatible habitat. Established legendary/mythical/Ultra-Beast special species stay reserved. The custom Darkrown is not added to regional wild pools.
policies.terrain: One profile applies to each entire map. Traversable grass, stairs and glass do not disable encounters. Furnished facilities, town streets, raid pens and unverified exports remain quiet; incidental water is not a land habitat.
policies.gen7: Existing Gen7 guide rows are audited individually. Only species with all six exact locally valid GIF sprites join generated habitat profiles. No runtime downloads, Normal-art substitution or database expansion.
policies.neutral_forms: 16 already-supported neutral guide names receive byte-identical aliases of documented existing form art, with each of the six varieties preserved. This is a fixed display choice; seasonal/gender/stance/form changes are not simulated.
